name: agentic-qe
description: Full test engineering lifecycle for greenfield and brownfield projects: repository analysis or BA user stories, risk-based planning, test design, test generation, isolated execution, healing, traceability and an offline release report, with human approval gates and enforced guardrails.

default_mode.title: Default project mode
default_mode.description: greenfield (no code yet, start from user stories), brownfield (existing code and tests), or auto (detect). Used when /qe-start gets no --mode flag.

output_dir.title: QE output folder
output_dir.description: Project-relative folder for generated QE documents. Created only after you approve it.

panel.title: Live QE pane
panel.description: auto opens the pane beside the transcript by itself and keeps a show bar above the prompt while it is hidden; command opens it only on /qe-pane or --watch; off never opens it.

open_browser.title: Open the dashboard in the browser
open_browser.description: Open the live dashboard in your browser when you send /agentic-qe:qe-start and after approve gate 0. Off in CI and remote shells without a display.

dashboard_port.title: Dashboard port
dashboard_port.description: The port the live dashboard always uses (1024 to 4190). The next free one is taken only when another project holds it.
